title: Reliable Agent Tool Calls
audience: Engineers who can read JSON and run tests
desired_transformation: Design and verify bounded agent tools with explicit failure contracts

provisions: Captions and transcripts for every video

source_map.notes_or_license: User-authorized internal source; quote only within the course workspace

outcomes.statement: Design a strict tool contract for a bounded agent action
outcomes.evidence_of_mastery: A reviewed schema that rejects out-of-scope and malformed actions

outcomes.statement: Verify tool arguments and failure behavior with executable tests
outcomes.evidence_of_mastery: Passing positive and negative tests against the supplied harness

lessons.title: Start from the boundary schema
lessons.objective: Write a strict input and output schema for one tool

exercise.instructions: Tighten a permissive schema until all supplied invalid fixtures fail closed

assessment.evidence: Schema and reviewer checklist meet every contract criterion

lessons.title: Test failure contracts
lessons.objective: Create passing tests for invalid and unavailable tool paths

exercise.instructions: Repair the implementation until every positive and negative fixture passes

assessment.evidence: The unchanged reference suite passes in the target environment

capstone.authentic_task: Design and test a new bounded tool from an ambiguous product request
capstone.rubric_or_acceptance_criteria: The schema is bounded, invalid paths fail closed, and all supplied tests pass
capstone.remediation_path: Repeat the failing contract lesson and resubmit only the failed rubric dimension
